runtime: convex-test native transaction oracle using production validators and authorized handlers

results.name: Pilot registrations preserve every production argument/return validator and public mutation flag
Role promotion and demotion atomically change projected write capability without rebuild calls
Unauthorized role changes, forged actors, cross-workspace targets and last-Owner changes remain denied
Upsert suspension and reactivation atomically remove and restore projections
Any required read-module denial clears only the affected actor while Owner commands still commit
Unexpected projection failures roll back the membership change and its activity atomically
Security disable and remove clear projections without an explicit rebuild

limitations: Native oracle injects identity; live protocol tests separately verify JWT authentication and replicated effects
Only the pilot exported user mutation paths have automatic invalidation; other ACL/identity/expiry paths remain release prerequisites
